# Time

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/components/`](../folders/src-view-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/components/time.h`](../../../src/view/components/time.h)

## Summary

Legacy in-game calendar clock in integer game seconds.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by TimeSys::preinit and only used by TimeSys. Game time advances by speed * speed_modifier * frame_dt * 10 game seconds per frame (truncated to uint64). The header also defines Date (calendar breakdown: 60 s, 60 min, 24 h, 28-day months, 4 months named Spring/Summer/Automn/Winter), which is not stored in a registry. Leftover of the archived tile-map simulation; nothing else reads it.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `current` | `time_t (uint64_t)` | 0 | Game seconds since start. |
| `speed` | `time_t` | 60 | Game seconds per real second (before the x10 factor and the modifier). |
| `speed_modifier` | `time_t` | 1 | 0 paused; radio buttons offer 0, 1, 3, 10, 50. |
| `last_speed_modifier` | `time_t` | 1 | Last non-zero modifier, restored when unpausing with P. |
| `dt` | `time_t` | 0 | Game seconds added this frame. |
| `minute / hour / day / month / year` | `static constexpr time_t` | 60 / 3600 / 86400 / 2419200 / 9676800 | Calendar constants. |
